name: extension
description: Chrome extension (Manifest V3): Angular popup and in-page UI, esbuild scripts.

scripts.build: ng build popup && ng build in-page && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.build:dev: ng build popup --configuration development && ng build in-page --configuration development && node scripts/build.mjs --dev && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.test: vitest run && ng test popup --watch=false && ng test in-page --watch=false
scripts.e2e: node e2e/smoke.mjs && node e2e/pipeline.mjs && node e2e/ui.mjs && node e2e/popup.mjs
